items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I know Berrigan was on it, I know that.

ctx.x: It was Froben, yeah. So Froben, who was in the band?

I wanted Berrigan, Froben, and I'll tell you the truth, I can't remember who else. It was one of them dates. It was kind of foggy. I don't know. I know Berrigan was on it, I know that. I knew we were a little disappointed because it didn't come out as good as we wanted it to come out. You know, didn't think it was good to be on it.
That's the one you told me you took a solo one?
